_source: Classiq Studio, Execute tab, backend simulator; recorded by the author

runs.note: 128 rows = 2^7, exactly the number of H gates in the fixed pattern; 9 of 16 qubits are deterministic, so this run is a correctness check, not an entropy source

counts are consistent after all: 17 267 nonzero bins of 65 536 average 1.16, the per-bin mean over all bins is 0.305, so the 3-4 counts at the top of the count-sorted table are the expected tail (~247 bins at >=3, ~19 at >=4)
runs.verdict: consistent with an unbiased uniform sampler

runs.note: counts export parsed (6-page PDF, 256 rows): counts sum to exactly 20000, so the Count column is honest; the earlier ~1.2-2.7x 'inflation' was an artefact of reading means off a count-sorted screenshot, not a Studio bug
runs.verdict: counts verified; P(1)=0.500400, chi2 uniformity p=0.527, 256/256 bins occupied

runs.note: 128 = number of even-parity 8-bit strings, which is exactly the X-basis GHZ signature; all 15 transcribed rows have even parity, zero odd-parity entries

correction.statement: An earlier note in this file claimed the displayed Count column exceeded the shot budget by 1.2-2.9x. The full counts export for the 8-qubit run sums to exactly Num Shots = 20000, so that claim was wrong and has been withdrawn. The apparent inflation came from comparing a mean read off a count-sorted first page against the true mean over all bins.
